title: Lionel Messi holds a baby Lamine Yamal – level 1
paragraphs: Lionel Messi and a young star named Lamine Yamal play against each other in the World Cup final.

Many years ago, Messi takes a photo holding Yamal as a small baby. Today, Messi says that this old photo is crazy. He thinks that Yamal is a fantastic player and one of the best in the world now. Yamal is only 19 years old, and he plays for Barcelona. Messi loves this club, so he wishes the young boy good luck.
But Messi also says that Argentina will work very hard to stop Yamal in the final game.

words.d: the last and most important game
